title: Valve says the Steam Deck OLED may be "intermittently" out of stock due to memory and storage shortages; it has been out of stock in the US for a few days (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: Valve says the Steam Deck OLED may be “intermittently” out of stock due to memory and storage shortages; it has been out of stock in the US for a few days — The PC gaming handheld has been out of stock in the US for a few days. … Valve has updated the Steam Deck OLED website …
contentText:
Jay Peters / The Verge :

Valve says the Steam Deck OLED may be “intermittently” out of stock due to memory and storage shortages; it has been out of stock in the US for a few days   —  The PC gaming handheld has been out of stock in the US for a few days. … Valve has updated the Steam Deck OLED website …
